observations.finding: 19 of 49 continuous CNV features significant at q<0.05; top features higher in C0001 include locus::VHL (Cliff's delta 0.516, q=0.0015), chr20q (0.500, q=0.0015), locus::SETD2 (0.487, q=0.0015), locus::PBRM1 (0.482, q=0.0015), locus::BAP1 (0.465, q=0.0022).

chr8p::loss enriched in C0001 (37.1% vs 7.3%, OR 7.47, 95% CI 2.07-26.96, q=0.0066); chr14q::loss directionally enriched (51.6% vs 24.4%, OR 3.31, q=0.057); chr20q::gain enriched (22.6% vs 4.9%, OR 5.69, q=0.159).

PBRM1 mutation depleted in C0001 (24.2% vs 58.5%, OR 0.226, 95% CI 0.097-0.529, q=0.017); VHL mutation depleted (41.9% vs 73.2%, OR 0.265, q=0.026); BAP1 mutation enriched (19.4% vs 2.4%, OR 9.6, q=0.100).

biological_support.statistical_interpretation: Coherent multi-feature CNV signal with strong effect sizes and adjusted significance, plus two significant WXS associations (PBRM1, VHL) and a directionally consistent BAP1 enrichment. The CNV and WXS patterns are internally coherent (VHL/PBRM1/SETD2/BAP1 locus involvement).
biological_support.medical_interpretation: C0001 shows a distinct molecular profile characterized by CNV alterations at ccRCC-relevant loci and differential mutation frequencies in PBRM1/VHL/BAP1, consistent with a biologically distinguishable subgroup. No prognostic or clinical claims are made.
limitations: RNA modality not available in this round; no transcriptomic corroboration.
BAP1 mutation enrichment is not significant after adjustment (q=0.100).
chr14q loss and chr20q gain do not reach q<0.05.

confounder_exclusion.statistical_interpretation: Modest but statistically significant technical associations exist, primarily with CT acquisition metadata and tissue source site. Effect sizes are moderate (V<0.5) and no numeric acquisition parameter is significant. The defining biological signal for C0001 is CNV/WXS-based, which is not directly driven by CT acquisition parameters.
confounder_exclusion.medical_interpretation: Technical factors provide a plausible but limited competing explanation; the moderate CT-scanner and site associations do not fully account for the molecular (CNV/WXS) signal. Confounding cannot be fully excluded given the site/scanner imbalance.
limitations: Tissue source site and CT scanner model are imbalanced between sets.
No adjustment for site/scanner was performed in the molecular analyses.
